Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp

Interface McpEndpointMixin

All Known Subinterfaces:
McpEndpoint, McpEndpoint
All Known Implementing Classes:
SpringExampleMcpServer, SpringMcpRestServlet, SpringMcpRestServlet
public interface McpEndpointMixin
Mixin interface that exposes an MCP JSON-RPC endpoint at POST /mcp on any Juneau REST resource.

Implementing classes supply their McpServerConfig via getMcpConfig() and their protocol revision via revision(). In practice a consumer implements a revision-specific sub-interface (for example org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20250618.McpEndpoint), which supplies revision() for them.

      subscriptionBroker
      

      default McpSubscriptionBroker subscriptionBroker()
      

      Optional subscription broker backing this endpoint's subscriptions/listen support.

 
      
 Returning null (the default) means this endpoint does not support subscriptions: no
 McpSubscriptionBroker or McpSubscriptions bean is added to the request-scoped
 BeanStore that handleMcpRequest(org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonrpc.JsonRpcRequest, org.apache.juneau.rest.server.RestRequest) builds.

 
      
 A revision binding that implements subscriptions/listen (for example
 org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.McpEndpoint) overrides this to return a
 binding-owned broker instance (its own per-binding vs. shared-instance semantics are that
 revision's own choice — see its Javadoc).
      

      

      Returns:
      

      The subscription broker, or null if this endpoint does not support subscriptions.

      handleMcpRequest
      

      default Object handleMcpRequest(@Content
 JsonRpcRequest req,
 RestRequest restReq)
      

      Default MCP JSON-RPC endpoint handler.

 
      
 Implementations may override this method to customize routing (path / annotations) but must
 still dispatch through revision().

 
      
 Applies the same serializer policy as AbstractMcpRestServlet (addBeanTypes and
 uriResolution="NONE"), so the two neutral HTTP entrypoints stay at parity.
      

      

      Parameters:
      

      req - JSON-RPC request envelope.
      

      restReq - The current REST request.
      

      Returns:
      

      The response, or null for notifications.
